tools.name: search_medicines
tools.description: Find Indian medicine brands, compositions (molecules) and companies by name in NPPA's price filings. Start here when you have a brand or generic name. Returns names, pack counts and counterfoil.in pages to cite.

tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: One Indian medicine brand: every pack with its MRP and price per unit as filed with NPPA, composition, whether it is price-controlled and its ceiling, and the cheapest other brands with the same composition and strength.

tools.name: compare_prices
tools.description: Every brand of one composition sold in India, lowest price per unit first, with the lowest, median and highest per-unit price for each strength and form. Use for 'cheapest <generic>' or 'how much should <generic> cost'.

tools.name: company_profile
tools.description: An Indian pharmaceutical company group in NPPA's filings: the names it files under, counts of packs, brands and molecules, its largest molecules, batches CDSCO declared not of standard quality, and packs filed above the price ceiling.

tools.name: failed_batches
tools.description: Drug batches that Indian government laboratories declared not of standard quality (CDSCO monthly alerts): product, batch, manufacturer, what it failed on, and the laboratory. Search by product or manufacturer, and/or a month.

tools.name: above_ceiling
tools.description: Price-controlled packs whose filed MRP per unit is above NPPA's own ceiling price plus GST, by brand, company or molecule, most above first, with the ceiling order cited.
